<a id="schema-batchsummarysettingsdto"></a>
### BatchSummarySettingsDto

Settings for the scheduled Batch History summary email.

Required: `id`, `isActive`, `lookbackHours`

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | int64 | yes | Row identifier, or 0 when the row does not exist yet. Zero is not an error — the update command creates the row on first save. |
| `isActive` | boolean | yes | Whether the scheduled summary is sent at all. |
| `emailRecipients` | string |  | Comma-separated recipient addresses. All recipients receive a single email. |
| `lookbackHours` | int32 | yes | How many hours back each run reports on. Should match the job's cron interval so consecutive runs neither overlap nor leave gaps. |

<a id="schema-dataflowresyncsettingsdto"></a>
### DataflowResyncSettingsDto

Settings for the scheduled Dataflow Resync job.

Required: `id`, `isActive`, `intervalHours`

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | int64 | yes |  |
| `isActive` | boolean | yes |  |
| `intervalHours` | int32 | yes | Hours between resync attempts for every enabled dataflow (1–24). |
| `dataflows` | [DataflowResyncRuleDto](#schema-dataflowresyncruledto)[] |  | Per-dataflow include flag. Only enabled rows are resynced. |
